title: It applies the TEAM10 discount starting at ten items
description: Verify the inclusive threshold, exact pricing response, and rounding down and half-cent rounding up through the pricing API.
testPlan: POST /api/pricing/quote with Content-Type: application/json and body {"subtotalCents":11691,"itemCount":9}; inspect the status and JSON response.
POST /api/pricing/quote with Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8 and body {"subtotalCents":12990,"itemCount":10}; inspect the status and JSON response.
POST /api/pricing/quote with Content-Type: application/json and body {"subtotalCents":14289,"itemCount":11}; inspect the status and JSON response.
POST /api/pricing/quote with Content-Type: application/json and body {"subtotalCents":19485,"itemCount":15}; inspect the status and JSON response.
inScope: TEAM10 eligibility below, at, and above ten items
Integer-cent totals, including rounding down and half-cent rounding up
outOfScope: Unchanged input validation and unrelated endpoints
entryCriteria: The pricing API is available at the target base URL.
exitCriteria: It returns HTTP 200 for each request.
It returns exactly {"subtotalCents":11691,"itemCount":9,"totalCents":11691} for nine items.
It returns exactly {"subtotalCents":12990,"itemCount":10,"totalCents":11691} for ten items.
It returns exactly {"subtotalCents":14289,"itemCount":11,"totalCents":12860} for eleven items.
It returns exactly {"subtotalCents":19485,"itemCount":15,"totalCents":17537} for fifteen items.
